findings.title: Drain can report Completed while a reconciled operation is persisted RecoveryBlocked via the OwnershipUnknown outcome
findings.detail: ArtworkLifecycleCoordinator.IsResolvedOperation treated ArtworkReconciliationOutcome.OwnershipUnknown as resolved even though ArtworkPublisher.ExecuteRecoveryAsync persists the operation as RecoveryBlocked. The correction removes IsResolvedOperation entirely; DrainCoreAsync now re-reads the durable operation after reconciliation and counts it resolved only when the durable phase is Committed or Aborted, otherwise it counts blockedOperations (a RecoveryBlocked or still-non-terminal or unreadable operation). A non-throwing source-read failure now yields ArtworkLifecycleOutcome.Incomplete. Verified by inspection (src/ArrTags/Artwork/ArtworkLifecycleCoordinator.cs:171-186) and by the new regression test DrainReportsIncompleteWhenAReadFailureMakesAnOperationRecoveryBlocked, which asserts Incomplete, OperationsReconciled == 0, the operation phase RecoveryBlocked, and zero image calls.

findings.title: Startup Reset() overwrote an invalid (corrupt) fence with Normal
findings.detail: ArtworkLifecycleFenceStore.Read() now reads the record directly through StateEnvelopeCodec.TryDeserialize without quarantining it, and Reset() returns early when the fence is invalid, so a corrupt fence is preserved and the publication read path stays fail-closed. The codec still validates the schema version and the payload SHA-256 integrity tag, and the previous repository read did not validate envelope kind/recordId/authority either, so no validation was lost. Verified by the new test ResetPreservesAnInvalidFenceInsteadOfOverwritingItWithNormal.

findings.title: Confirmed item-removal result was returned even when the reconciler did not tombstone the in-flight operation
findings.detail: HandleItemRemovedCoreAsync now returns Blocked with tombstoned:false when the durable operation record is invalid/quarantined, when the state record is invalid/quarantined, or when the post-reconcile operation is not actually Aborted; it claims a tombstone only after the reconciler aborted the in-flight operation. Verified by the new test ConfirmedItemRemovalWithAnInvalidStateDoesNotClaimATombstone, which asserts Blocked, Tombstoned == false, the operation still MutationStarted, and zero image calls.

findings.title: StopAsync's drain bound is cooperative, not a hard timeout
findings.detail: ArrTagsLifecycleService.StopAsync links the shutdown token and uses CancelAfter(_boundedDrainTimeout) but awaits the coordinator directly rather than Task.WaitAsync. Every in-repo await honors the token, so the documented 15s bound holds in practice; a host API that ignores cancellation could still extend shutdown. Non-blocking defense-in-depth note retained.

findings.title: No direct tests for Plugin.OnUninstalling glue or StateRepository.Enumerate
findings.detail: Focused tests were added: three Plugin.OnUninstalling cases (resolves the coordinator and drains the Uninstall fence, contains a coordinator failure, and is safe without a resolvable coordinator) and nine StateRepository.Enumerate / PluginStatePaths.GetKindDirectory cases (path under authority root, unsafe-kind rejection, deterministic ordering, requested bound, invalid-record omission, unsafe filename skip, and missing kind directory). All are meaningful and assert the relevant behavior.

findings.title: Removal test mutates the process-global BaseItem.FileSystem static
findings.detail: JellyfinArtworkImageWriterTests.RemoveImageUsesTheSupportedDeletionFlowAndNeverTheProvider replaces the static BaseItem.FileSystem with a DispatchProxy and performs a real temp-file delete, restoring the previous value in a finally block. No other test uses BaseItem.FileSystem, so the risk is low; non-blocking test-isolation note retained.
